Cautiously positive, but more guarded when incorporating the Financial Stability Report. The FOMC’s commitment to keep rates at 0–0.25%, continue Treasury/MBS purchases, and use forward guidance supports demand and credit, aligning with accommodative financial conditions. However, the FSR underscores elevated financial vulnerabilities—stretched asset valuations, high business leverage, and fragilities in short‑term funding and nonbank intermediation—plus ongoing pandemic-related downside risks. These FSR insights temper the optimism in the statement, shifting the overall tone to mildly positive with greater caution.
